name: Zanubrutinib Monotherapy (Waldenström Macroglobulinemia)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Waldenström Macroglobulinemia / Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS Landmark Regimen: Phase III ASPEN Trial (Tam et al. Blood 2020)

supportiveCare: Hemorrhage precautions: hold zanubrutinib 3-7 days before and after minor/major surgical procedures.
Infection prophylaxis: consider PCP/anti-infective prophylaxis in patients at high risk of recurrent infections.
Monitor for cardiac arrhythmias (atrial fibrillation/flutter, though lower incidence than ibrutinib per ASPEN trial).
monitoring: Serum IgM and serum protein electrophoresis (SPEP) every 1-3 months
ECG/cardiac evaluation if palpitations or dyspnea occur

doseModificationRules.text: Hold zanubrutinib until ANC >= 1,000/mcL and platelets >= 50,000/mcL. Resume at same dose for 1st occurrence, reduce to 80 mg PO BID for 2nd recurrence.
Hold until toxicity resolves to Grade <= 1. Resume at 80 mg PO BID.

drugs.name: Zanubrutinib
drugs.notes: Zanubrutinib 160 mg PO twice daily (or 320 mg PO once daily) continuously. Second-generation BTK inhibitor with superior VGPR rates and improved safety/tolerability (significantly lower afib and bleeding) vs ibrutinib in the Phase III ASPEN trial.
